notes: ACCESS: Tier (a) HTTP-first only, fully successful - robots.txt (Shopify default, User-agent: * / Allow: /, no anthropic-ai/ClaudeBot/Claude-Web disallow) permits fetch tools; no blocks encountered. Used curl_cffi impersonating chrome124. TREE: Site is a Shopify store. Built the full mega-menu by fetching the homepage HTML and parsing every site-nav dropdown (top-level tabs: Ganesha, Graphic Works, Home Decor, Artefacts, Accessories, Souvenirs, Shop by Price) plus the footer 'Shop' and 'Shop by price' menus (both a subset of the same nav, no new nodes). Cross-referenced against /collections.json (201 collections) and /sitemap_collections_1.xml (201 URLs, same set) to check for any nav-adjacent categories not rendered in the header HTML. This surfaced several bare/orphaned collection handles not linked from any nav or footer menu (e.g. cushion-covers, cushion-covers-graphic, soft-furnishings, small-organizers, toran-hangings, plus junk collections test111/test222/test333 and 'globo_basis_collection - Do not delete') - these are stray/legacy Shopify collections outside the site's actual navigable taxonomy and were excluded from the tree (soft-furnishings in particular has 0 products and is not linked anywhere). The homepage also has a promotional 'Collections' carousel section (h2 heading literally 'Collections') listing themed/seasonal product lines (Vankatha, Elephant Floral, Madhubani, Ajrakh, Royal Jharokha, Bani Thani, Regal Mayura, Navy Floral, Mughal Floral, Blue Pottery, King Procession, Dwaar) - these are marketing sub-collections of the cushion-cover product line, not standard nav category/subcategory pages, excluded per rule 15/27 (seasonal/promotional collection landing pages). QTY: exact unique-product-id count via paginated /collections/<handle>/products.json (limit=250, looped until an empty page); canonical URL on each fetched collection page matched the requested handle (confirming no silent parent/sitewide-total substitution). EXCLUDED (not Textile/Storage, confirmed by nav placement and/or product-sample check): Ganesha and all its material subcats (idols/artefacts task); Graphic Works > Tableware/Drinkware/Bags/Diaries/Umbrellas/T-Shirts (Kitchen&Dining/apparel/stationery, out of scope); Home Decor > Wall Accents (Frames, Clocks, Paintings - Wall Decor task); Home Decor > Home Accents > Lighting, Diyas, Bells, Chowki (Lighting/Decorative/Furniture task); Home Decor > Home Accents > Toran and Hangings (26 products sampled - predominantly brass/lacquered-wood/copper wall hangings and wind chimes with only a handful of fabric/cotton-filled pieces mixed in; the collection as a whole is a general decorative wall-hanging category, not a genuine textile subcategory, so it belongs to Wall Decor/Decorative Home Accessories task territory, not Textile); Home Decor > Dining (Tableware/Serveware/Drinkware - Kitchen & Dining task); Home Decor > Furniture; Artefacts and all its idol/decor subcats (idols, Ashoka Pillars, Urli, Singing Bowl - Decorative/Artefacts, not Storage despite 'holding' potential); Accessories > Sling Bags/Tote Bags/Laptop Bags/Wallets/Wellness/Jewellery/Wraps/T-Shirts/Other Accessories (personal-carry fashion bags and apparel per textile.md rule 19/storage.md rule 6 exclusion - primary purpose is personal carrying/apparel, not home textile or home storage); Souvenirs (stationery, mementos, dolls, toys - out of scope); Shop by Price / Gifts under price bands (price-based, not category). INCLUDED: Home Decor > Cushion Covers (leaf, no further subcategory in nav) and Graphic Works > Cushion Covers (leaf, themed/printed subset) both genuinely list cushion covers (product-sample confirmed: satin/canvas/brocade cushion covers, no non-textile noise) - kept as two separate rows since they are two distinct nav paths with distinct URLs and distinct (overlapping but not identical) product sets; nav parents (Home Decor, Graphic Works) are general mega-menu tabs, not Textile-named groups, so both recorded as ungrouped leaves per the established convention (matches sibling worker files where a non-Textile/Storage-named nav parent yields an ungrouped leaf row). Home Decor > Home Accents > Small Organizers (16 products sampled: wooden chest-of-drawers, pencil box, jewellery/trinket boxes, gift boxes) - website's own category name 'Small Organizers' directly matches storage.md's own defined 'Organizers' group name (rule 3/7); included as Storage with MEDIUM confidence since a couple of sampled items (Chess King & Queen Decor, Daisy Flower Trinket Box) skew purely decorative rather than storage-functional; nav parent 'Home Accents' is a general decor group, not Storage-named, so recorded as an ungrouped leaf.
